/* =================== model (frozen DEV) =================== */
const FIDX = {}; MD.field_ids.forEach((f, i) => FIDX[f] = i);
function relMean(target, set) { if (!set.length) return 0; let s = 0; set.forEach(r => s += MD.phi[FIDX[target]][FIDX[r]]); return s / set.length; }
function softmaxModel(cand, coefs, d0Override) {
  const z = cand.map((c, j) => {
    let v = 0;
    for (let k = 0; k < 7; k++) { const x = (k === 6 && d0Override) ? d0Override[j] : c[1 + k]; v += coefs[k] * (x - MD.mean[k]) / MD.sd[k]; }
    return v;
  });
  const mx = Math.max(...z), e = z.map(v => Math.exp(v - mx)), s = e.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  return e.map(v => v / s);
}
const rankOf = (p, i) => 1 + p.filter(v => v > p[i]).length;
const CASE = {}; CS.rows.forEach(c => CASE[c.id] = c);
const EX = CASE[EXID];
/* candidate row layout: [field, a_phi_home, b_log_size, c_density, e_gate_own, D_rca_1y, D_vol, d0, p2, p3, y] */

/* =================== paired-bar chart for a stratum =================== */
function pairBars(container, c, pA, pB, o) {
  const idx = c.cand.map((_, i) => i).sort((a, b) => pB[b] - pA[a] * 0 - pB[a] || 0);
  idx.sort((a, b) => pB[b] - pB[a]);
  const show = o.limit ? idx.slice(0, o.limit) : idx;
  const W = width(container), labW = Math.min(W * 0.44, Math.max(...show.map(i => textW(fname(c.cand[i][0]), 12.5, 600))) + 10);
  const rowH = 26, m = {l: labW + 8, r: 44, t: 6, b: 40}, H = m.t + m.b + show.length * rowH;
  const s = newSvg(container, W, H, o.label);
  const mx = Math.max(...show.map(i => Math.max(pA[i], pB[i]))) * 1.08, sx = v => m.l + v / mx * (W - m.l - m.r);
  const ticks = niceTicks(0, mx, W < 500 ? 3 : 5);
  ticks.forEach(t => { el("line", {x1: sx(t), x2: sx(t), y1: m.t, y2: H - m.b, class: "gl"}, s); tx(s, sx(t), H - m.b + 15, (t * 100).toFixed(0) + "%", {class: "tick", "text-anchor": "middle"}); });
  tx(s, (m.l + W - m.r) / 2, H - 6, o.xTitle || "Within-stratum choice probability", {class: "axt", "text-anchor": "middle"});
  show.forEach((i, r) => {
    const y = m.t + r * rowH, row = c.cand[i], ent = row[10] === 1;
    const g = el("g", {}, s);
    el("rect", {class: "hit", x: 2, y: y + 1, width: W - 4, height: rowH - 2, fill: ent ? "rgba(179,92,0,.07)" : "transparent", rx: 4}, g);
    tx(g, m.l - 8, y + rowH / 2 + 4, fname(row[0]), {"text-anchor": "end", "font-size": 12.5, "font-weight": ent ? 700 : 400, fill: ent ? "var(--ink)" : "var(--ink2)"});
    el("rect", {x: m.l, y: y + 4, width: Math.max(0.5, sx(pA[i]) - m.l), height: 8, fill: o.colA || "var(--base)"}, g);
    el("rect", {x: m.l, y: y + 13, width: Math.max(0.5, sx(pB[i]) - m.l), height: 8, fill: "var(--accent)"}, g);
    if (ent) el("rect", {x: m.l - 1, y: y + 2, width: Math.max(sx(pA[i]), sx(pB[i])) - m.l + 3, height: 21, fill: "none", stroke: "var(--warn)", "stroke-width": 2, rx: 2}, g);
    tx(g, sx(pB[i]) + 4, y + 21, (pB[i] * 100).toFixed(1) + "%", {"font-size": 11, fill: "var(--muted)"});
    const rA = rankOf(pA, i), rB = rankOf(pB, i);
    markify(g, `${fname(row[0])}: ${o.nameA} ${(pA[i] * 100).toFixed(1)}%, ${o.nameB} ${(pB[i] * 100).toFixed(1)}%${ent ? ", entered" : ""}`,
      `<b>${esc(CS.fields[row[0]])}</b>${ent ? " (entered this year)" : ""}<br>${o.nameA}: ${(pA[i] * 100).toFixed(2)}% (rank ${rA})<br>${o.nameB}: ${(pB[i] * 100).toFixed(2)}% (rank ${rB})<br>d₀ ${o.d0 ? o.d0[i].toFixed(3) : row[7].toFixed(3)} · relatedness to home ${row[1].toFixed(3)} · log size ${row[2].toFixed(2)}`);
  });
}

  {t: "Add retained-frontier relatedness", s: "d₀"},
  {t: "Score with R3 and compare", s: "R3 choice"}];
let stage = 0;
function drawPipe() {

  const nodeW = (W - 12) / per - 14, nodeH = 40, H = rows * (nodeH + 16) + 4;
  const s = newSvg(C, W, H, "Pipeline diagram"); s.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
  STAGES.forEach((st, i) => {
    const r = Math.floor(i / per), c = i % per, x = 6 + c * (nodeW + 14), y = 4 + r * (nodeH + 16), on = i === stage, done = i < stage;
    if (c < per - 1 && i < STAGES.length - 1) el("line", {x1: x + nodeW, x2: x + nodeW + 14, y1: y + nodeH / 2, y2: y + nodeH / 2, stroke: "#9aa1a9", "stroke-width": 1.5}, s);
    const g = el("g", {style: "cursor:pointer"}, s);
    el("rect", {x, y, width: nodeW, height: nodeH, rx: 8, fill: on ? "var(--accent)" : done ? "var(--accent-soft)" : "#fff", stroke: on || done ? "var(--accent)" : "#b9bec5", "stroke-width": 1.5}, g);

    tx(g, x + nodeW / 2, y + nodeH / 2 + 4, label, {"text-anchor": "middle", "font-size": fs, "font-weight": 600, fill: on ? "#fff" : "var(--ink2)"});

}
function chipsHTML(c, enteredField) {
  const ids = MD.field_ids;
  return `<div class="chips">` + ids.map(f => {
    let cls = "cand", why = "candidate (not yet entered)";
    if (c.home.includes(f)) { cls = "home"; why = "home field"; }
    else if (c.retained.includes(f)) { cls = "ret"; why = "retaining"; }
    else if (c.entered_off.includes(f)) { cls = "lostc"; why = "entered, not retaining"; }
    const inCand = c.cand.some(r => r[0] === f);
    if (!inCand && cls === "cand") { cls = ""; why = "not in the risk set"; }
    if (f === enteredField) cls += " entered";
    return `<span class="chip ${cls}" title="${why}">${esc(fname(f))}</span>`;
  }).join("") + `</div><div class="legend" style="margin-top:8px"><span><i class="sw" style="background:var(--ink)"></i>Home</span><span><i class="sw" style="background:var(--accent)"></i>Retaining</span><span><i class="sw" style="background:var(--base-soft);border:1px solid var(--base)"></i>Entered, not retaining</span><span><i class="sw" style="background:#fff;border:1px dashed #7a828b"></i>Candidate</span><span><i class="sw" style="background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--warn)"></i>Entered in ${c.year}</span></div>`;
}
function renderStage() {
  const c = EX, ent = c.cand.findIndex(r => r[10] === 1), entF = c.cand[ent][0];
  const p2 = c.cand.map(r => r[8]), p3 = c.cand.map(r => r[9]);
  const live2 = softmaxModel(c.cand, MD.R2), live3 = softmaxModel(c.cand, MD.R3);

  const vis = $("#stage-vis"), io = $("#stage-io");
  const set = (a, b, cc, d) => io.innerHTML = `<dt>In</dt><dd>${a}</dd><dt>Done</dt><dd>${b}</dd><dt>Out</dt><dd>${cc}</dd><dt>Why</dt><dd>${d}</dd>`;
  const homeN = c.home.map(fname).join(", "), retN = c.retained.map(fname).join(", ");
  $("#stage-title").textContent = `${stage + 1}. ${STAGES[stage].t}`;
  if (stage === 0) {
    set(`OpenAlex works whose titles match the legacy concept label <strong>${esc(c.name)}</strong> (${c.cid}, Wikidata ${c.qid}).`,
      `Title matching with a per-concept precision gate; the <button class="term" data-term="t0">onset year</button> and <button class="term" data-term="home">home field</button> are fixed from the grounded papers.`,
      `<i>t</i><sub>0</sub> = <strong>${c.t0}</strong>; home: <strong>${esc(homeN)}</strong>. The record sits in the held-out ${esc(UNIT_LABEL[c.unit])} group.`,
      `Everything later is measured relative to onset and to the home field, so "off-home" and "entry" have a fixed reference.`);
    vis.innerHTML = `<div class="cols2"><div class="stat"><div class="v">${c.t0}</div><div class="l">Onset year t₀</div></div><div class="stat"><div class="v">${esc(homeN)}</div><div class="l">Home field</div></div><div class="stat"><div class="v">${c.year}</div><div class="l">Year of the choice followed here</div></div><div class="stat"><div class="v">${c.cand.length}</div><div class="l">Candidate fields that year</div></div></div>`;
  } else if (stage === 1) {

      `${c.entered_off.length} off-home fields entered by ${c.year - 1}; <strong>${c.retained.length} retaining</strong>: ${esc(retN)}.${c.entered_off.length > c.retained.length ?       `${c.cand.length} candidate rows. The table shows the four base covariates and <i>d</i><sub>0</sub>; RCA density and volume density are also recorded.`,
      `The <button class="term" data-term="clogit">conditional logit</button> compares fields only within this set, so concept-level traits cancel out.`);
    const rows = c.cand.slice().sort((a, b) => b[2] - a[2]);

      rows.map(r => `<tr${r[10] ? ' class="hl"' : ""}><td>${esc(fname(r[0]))}${r[10] ? " (entered)" : ""}</td><td>${r[1].toFixed(3)}</td><td>${r[2].toFixed(2)}</td><td>${r[3].toFixed(3)}</td><td>${r[4].toFixed(3)}</td><td>${r[7].toFixed(3)}</td></tr>`).join("") + `</tbody></table></div>`;
  } else if (stage === 3) {
    set(`The risk-set covariates without <i>d</i><sub>0</sub>: relatedness to home, log field size, entered-field density, own gateway centrality, RCA density and volume density.`,
      `Standardise with development-set means and SDs, weight by coefficients frozen on the development set, softmax within the concept-year.`,
      `${esc(fname(entF))}, the field actually entered in ${c.year}, gets <strong>${(p2[ent] * 100).toFixed(1)}%</strong> and ranks <strong>${rankOf(p2, ent)} of ${c.cand.length}</strong>.`,

    vis.querySelectorAll("rect[fill='var(--accent)']").forEach(r => r.setAttribute("fill", "var(--base)"));
  } else if (stage === 4) {

    const mean = relMean(entF, c.retained);

      `A field close to where the concept has stuck should be an easier next step than one close only to the home field.`);

    const W = width(vis), labW = Math.min(W * 0.46, Math.max(...idx.map(i => textW(fname(c.cand[i][0]), 12.5, 600))) + 10), rowH = 22, m = {l: labW + 8, r: 40, t: 4, b: 40}, H = m.t + m.b + idx.length * rowH;

    tx(s, (m.l + W - m.r) / 2, H - 6, "d₀: mean backbone relatedness to retaining fields", {class: "axt", "text-anchor": "middle"});
    idx.forEach((i, r) => {

      el("rect", {class: "hit", x: 2, y, width: W - 4, height: rowH, fill: "transparent", rx: 4}, g);
      tx(g, m.l - 8, y + rowH / 2 + 4, fname(row[0]), {"text-anchor": "end", "font-size": 12.5, "font-weight": e ? 700 : 400});
      el("rect", {x: m.l, y: y + 5, width: Math.max(0.5, sx(row[7]) - m.l), height: 12, fill: e ? "var(--warn)" : "var(--accent)"}, g);
      tx(g, sx(row[7]) + 4, y + 15, row[7].toFixed(3), {"font-size": 11, fill: "var(--muted)"});
      markify(g, `${fname(row[0])}: d0 ${row[7].toFixed(3)}`, `<b>${esc(CS.fields[row[0]])}</b>${e ? " (entered)" : ""}<br>recorded d₀ ${row[7].toFixed(3)}; recomputed ${relMean(row[0], c.retained).toFixed(3)}`);
    });
  } else {
    set(`All seven covariates, now including <i>d</i><sub>0</sub>.`,
      `Same standardise, weight and softmax, with the R3 coefficients frozen on the development set.`,
      `${esc(fname(entF))} rises from ${(p2[ent] * 100).toFixed(1)}% (rank ${rankOf(p2, ent)}) to <strong>${(p3[ent] * 100).toFixed(1)}%</strong> (rank <strong>${rankOf(p3, ent)}</strong>). The page's own evaluation of both models matches the recorded probabilities to within ${dmax.toFixed(4)}, the rounding of the recorded inputs.`,
      `Summed over thousands of such choices, these small shifts are what the held-out coefficient <i>d</i><sub>0</sub> measures.`);

function go(i) { stage = Math.max(0, Math.min(STAGES.length - 1, i)); renderStage(); }
(function initStepper() {

/* =================== 3a. BROWSER =================== */

  const gain = c.rank_R2.reduce((a, v, i) => a + v - c.rank_R3[i], 0);

let selId = EXID, tryCase = EX;
(function initBrowser() {
  $("#browser-rule").textContent = `The page embeds a ${CS.rule.replace("strata", "strata")} from the ${RK.rows.length.toLocaleString("en-US")} held-out strata (plus the stepper's example), with every candidate row the run recorded for them. Counts in "Where it fails" use all strata.`;
  const us = ["", ...RK.units];
  $("#f-unit").innerHTML = us.map(u => `<option value="${u}">${u ? esc(UNIT_LABEL[u]) : "All held-out groups and cohort"}</option>`).join("");
  ["#f-unit", "#f-sort", "#f-fail"].forEach(q => $(q).addEventListener("change", renderList));
  $("#f-search").addEventListener("input", renderList);
})();
function filtered() {
  const u = $("#f-unit").value, q = $("#f-search").value.trim().toLowerCase(), fail = $("#f-fail").checked, sort = $("#f-sort").value;
  let L = CASES.filter(c => (!u || c.unit === u) && (!q || c.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)) && (!fail || c.gain < 0));
  const cmp = {gain: (a, b) => b.gain - a.gain || a.name.localeCompare(b.name), loss: (a, b) => a.gain - b.gain || a.name.localeCompare(b.name),
    name: (a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name) || a.year - b.year, year: (a, b) => a.year - b.year || a.name.localeCompare(b.name)}[sort];
  return L.sort(cmp);
}
function renderList() {
  const L = filtered(), ul = $("#b-list");
  const nUp = L.filter(c => c.gain > 0).length, nDn = L.filter(c => c.gain < 0).length;
  $("#b-count").textContent = `${L.length} of ${CASES.length} strata shown: the entered field moves up in ${nUp}, down in ${nDn}, and keeps its rank in ${L.length - nUp - nDn}.`;
  ul.innerHTML = L.map(c => {
    const b = c.gain > 0 ? `<span class="badge up">up ${c.gain}</span>` : c.gain < 0 ? `<span class="badge down">down ${-c.gain}</span>` : `<span class="badge same">same</span>`;
    return `<li><button type="button" data-id="${c.id}" aria-pressed="${c.id === selId}">${esc(c.name)} · ${c.year}${b}<span class="meta">${esc(UNIT_LABEL[c.unit])} · rank ${c.rank_R2.join(",")} → ${c.rank_R3.join(",")} of ${c.cand.length}</span></button></li>`;
  }).join("") || `<li style="padding:12px">No stratum matches.</li>`;
  ul.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b => b.addEventListener("click", () => select(b.dataset.id)));
  if (L.length && !L.some(c => c.id === selId)) select(L[0].id, true); else renderDetail();
}
function select(id, quiet) {
  selId = id; tryCase = CASE[id];
  document.querySelectorAll("#b-list button").forEach(b => b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", b.dataset.id === id));
  renderDetail(); renderTry();
}
function renderDetail() {
  const c = CASE[selId]; if (!c) return;
  const p2 = c.cand.map(r => r[8]), p3 = c.cand.map(r => r[9]);
  const ents = c.cand.map((r, i) => r[10] ? i : -1).filter(i => i >= 0);
  const home = c.home.map(fname).join(", "), ret = c.retained.map(fname).join(", ") || "none";
  $("#b-head").innerHTML = `<h4 style="margin-top:0">${esc(c.name)}, ${c.year}</h4><p class="note" style="margin-bottom:6px">${esc(UNIT_LABEL[c.unit])} · onset ${c.t0} · home: ${esc(home)} · retaining in ${c.year - 1}: ${esc(ret)} · ${c.cand.length} candidates</p>`;
  pairBars($("#b-chart"), c, p2, p3, {label: `Choice probabilities for ${c.name} in ${c.year}`, nameA: "R2", nameB: "R3"});
  const parts = ents.map(i => `${fname(c.cand[i][0])} (d₀ ${c.cand[i][7].toFixed(3)}) goes from rank ${rankOf(p2, i)} to ${rankOf(p3, i)}`);
  const g = c.gain;
  $("#b-take").textContent = `Entered: ${parts.join("; ")}. ` + (g > 0 ? "Adding retained-frontier relatedness moves the entered field up." : g < 0 ? "Here the retained-frontier term moves the entered field down: the concept went somewhere its retaining fields do not point to." : "Here the retained-frontier term leaves the entered field's rank unchanged.");
}

/* =================== 3b. INDICATORS =================== */
const IND_NAME = {M0_density_end: "Cumulative density of entered fields", D_vol_end: "Volume weighted density", CONTACT_REACH: "Contact reach (off-home fields entered)",
  n_comm_W3: "Communities among co-occurrence neighbours", NOV: "Neighbourhood novelty", RETENTION_RATIO_early: "Retention ratio of contacted fields", ego_density_W3: "Ego network density"};
const IUNITS = ["PHYS", "LIFEENV", "SOC", "MATHDEC", "COH_DEVHOME", "COH_OTHER"];
function fillIndSelect() {
  const o = $("#i-out").value, L = IND.screen[o].filter(r => r.in_top10 || r.confirmed);
  const cur = $("#i-ind").value;
  L.sort((a, b) => (b.confirmed - a.confirmed) || Math.abs(b.pooled) - Math.abs(a.pooled));
  $("#i-ind").innerHTML = `<optgroup label="Confirmed on held-out data">` + L.filter(r => r.confirmed).map(r => `<option value="${r.indicator}">${esc(IND_NAME[r.indicator] || r.indicator)} (${r.family})</option>`).join("") + `</optgroup><optgroup label="Frozen but not confirmed">` + L.filter(r => !r.confirmed).map(r => `<option value="${r.indicator}">${esc(IND_NAME[r.indicator] || r.indicator)} (${r.family})</option>`).join("") + `</optgroup>`;
  if ([...$("#i-ind").options].some(x => x.value === cur)) $("#i-ind").value = cur;
}
function drawInd() {
  const o = $("#i-out").value, r = IND.screen[o].find(x => x.indicator === $("#i-ind").value);
  const nm = IND_NAME[r.indicator] || r.indicator;
  const rows = IUNITS.map(u => ({label: UNIT_LABEL[u], est: r.per_unit[u], lo: r.per_unit_ci[u][0], hi: r.per_unit_ci[u][1],
    valtxt: `${s3(r.per_unit[u])} [${s3(r.per_unit_ci[u][0])}, ${s3(r.per_unit_ci[u][1])}]`,
    tip: `<b>${esc(UNIT_LABEL[u])}</b><br>partial Spearman ${s3(r.per_unit[u])} [${s3(r.per_unit_ci[u][0])}, ${s3(r.per_unit_ci[u][1])}]<br>n = ${r.per_unit_n[u].toLocaleString("en-US")} concepts`}));
  rows.push({label: "DL pool, 4 groups", est: r.pooled, lo: r.lo, hi: r.hi, bold: true, shape: "diamond", color: "var(--ink)", valtxt: `${s3(r.pooled)} [${s3(r.lo)}, ${s3(r.hi)}]`,
    tip: `<b>DL pool of the four held-out groups</b><br>${s3(r.pooled)} [${s3(r.lo)}, ${s3(r.hi)}], I² = ${r.I2.toFixed(2)}${r.holm_p != null ? `<br>Holm-adjusted p = ${r.holm_p < 1e-3 ? r.holm_p.toExponential(1) : r.holm_p.toFixed(3)}` : ""}`});
  const lo = Math.min(-0.3, ...rows.map(x => x.lo)), hi = Math.max(0.5, ...rows.map(x => x.hi));
  forest($("#ind-chart"), rows, {xmin: Math.floor(lo * 10) / 10, xmax: Math.ceil(hi * 10) / 10, xTitle: "Partial Spearman with breadth, given B5", label: `Per-body estimates for ${nm}`});
  const pos = IUNITS.filter(u => Math.sign(r.per_unit[u]) === Math.sign(r.pooled)).length;
  const excl = IUNITS.filter(u => r.per_unit_ci[u][0] > 0 || r.per_unit_ci[u][1] < 0).length;
  $("#ind-take").textContent = r.confirmed
    ? `${nm} is confirmed: pooled ${s3(r.pooled)} [${s3(r.lo)}, ${s3(r.hi)}] with I² = ${r.I2.toFixed(2)}, the same sign in ${pos} of 6 bodies, and ${excl} of 6 body intervals excluding zero.${r.I2 > 0.5 ? " The spread across bodies is large, so the size of the effect is domain-dependent." : ""}`
    : `${nm} was frozen on the development set but is not confirmed on held-out data: pooled ${s3(r.pooled)} [${s3(r.lo)}, ${s3(r.hi)}], same sign as the pool in ${pos} of 6 bodies.`;
}
function drawLearn() {
  const o = $("#i-out").value, L = IND.learned[o], units = [...IUNITS, "POOLED_HELDOUT"];
  const C = $("#learn-chart"), W = width(C), narrow = W < 560;
  const lab = u => u === "POOLED_HELDOUT" ? "Held-out pool" : UNIT_LABEL[u];
  const labW = Math.min(W * 0.46, Math.max(...units.map(u => textW(lab(u), 13, 700))) + 10);
  const m = {l: labW + 8, r: narrow ? 14 : 70, t: 6, b: 44}, rowH = 34, H = m.t + m.b + units.length * rowH;
  const s = newSvg(C, W, H, "Spearman correlation of B5 and the learned model with breadth");
  const sx = v => m.l + v * (W - m.l - m.r);
  niceTicks(0, 1, narrow ? 4 : 5).forEach(t => { el("line", {x1: sx(t), x2: sx(t), y1: m.t, y2: H - m.b, class: "gl"}, s); tx(s, sx(t), H - m.b + 15, t.toFixed(1), {class: "tick", "text-anchor": "middle"}); });
  tx(s, (m.l + W - m.r) / 2, H - 8, "Spearman correlation with breadth (held-out)", {class: "axt", "text-anchor": "middle"});
  units.forEach((u, i) => {
    const v = L[u], y = m.t + i * rowH, g = el("g", {}, s), pooled = u === "POOLED_HELDOUT";
    el("rect", {class: "hit", x: 2, y: y + 1, width: W - 4, height: rowH - 2, fill: "transparent", rx: 4}, g);
    tx(g, m.l - 8, y + rowH / 2 + 4, lab(u), {"text-anchor": "end", "font-size": 13, "font-weight": pooled ? 700 : 400});
    el("rect", {x: m.l, y: y + 5, width: sx(v.B5) - m.l, height: 11, fill: "var(--base)"}, g);
    el("rect", {x: m.l, y: y + 17, width: sx(v.learned) - m.l, height: 11, fill: "var(--accent)"}, g);
    if (!narrow) tx(g, W - 4, y + rowH / 2 + 4, s3(v.delta), {"text-anchor": "end", "font-size": 12, fill: "var(--ink)", "font-weight": 600});
    markify(g, `${lab(u)}: B5 ${v.B5.toFixed(3)}, learned ${v.learned.toFixed(3)}`, `<b>${esc(lab(u))}</b> (n = ${v.n.toLocaleString("en-US")})<br>B5 ${v.B5.toFixed(3)} → ElasticNet ${v.learned.toFixed(3)}<br>gain ${s3(v.delta)} [${s3(v.lo)}, ${s3(v.hi)}]`);
  });
  if (!narrow) tx(s, W - 4, m.t - 0 + 2, "", {});
  const P = L.POOLED_HELDOUT, minU = IUNITS.reduce((a, u) => L[u].delta < L[a].delta ? u : a, IUNITS[0]);
  $("#learn-take").textContent = `On the held-out pool the ElasticNet reaches ${P.learned.toFixed(3)} against the baseline's ${P.B5.toFixed(3)}, a gain of ${s3(P.delta)} [${s3(P.lo)}, ${s3(P.hi)}]. Every body gains; the smallest gain is ${s3(L[minU].delta)} in ${UNIT_LABEL[minU]}.`;
}
$("#i-out").addEventListener("change", () => { fillIndSelect(); drawInd(); drawLearn(); });
$("#i-ind").addEventListener("change", drawInd);

/* =================== 3c. DECOMPOSITION =================== */
let dVar = "iv_vol_noMed_PR1";
(function () {
  const bodies = [...new Set(DEC.rows.map(r => r.body))];
  $("#d-body").innerHTML = bodies.map(b => `<option value="${b}">${esc(DEC.rows.find(r => r.body === b).label)}</option>`).join("");
  $("#d-body").value = "HELDOUT";
  $("#d-body").addEventListener("change", drawDec);
})();
function drawDec() {
  const r = DEC.rows.find(x => x.body === $("#d-body").value && x.variant === dVar) || DEC.rows.find(x => x.body === $("#d-body").value);
  const C = $("#dec-chart"), W = width(C), narrow = W < 560;
  const comps = [["E2", "Early contact E₂", r.s_E2, r.ci_E2, "var(--green)"], ["M", "Frontier advance M", r.s_M, r.ci_M, "#b8bec5"], ["rho", "Retention ρ", r.s_rho, r.ci_rho, "var(--accent)"]];
  const labs = ["Total gap", ...comps.map(c => c[1])];
  const lo = Math.min(0, ...comps.map(c => c[3] ? c[3][0] : c[2])) - 0.05, hi = Math.max(1, ...comps.map(c => c[3] ? c[3][1] : c[2])) + 0.02;
  const yT = niceTicks(lo, hi, 5), yw = Math.max(...yT.map(t => textW(t.toFixed(1), 12)));
  const m = {l: 24 + yw + 14, r: 12, t: 16, b: narrow ? 50 : 40}, H = 300;
  const s = newSvg(C, W, H, "Share of the breadth gap by channel");
  const bw = (W - m.l - m.r) / 4, sx = i => m.l + (i + 0.5) * bw, sy = v => m.t + (hi - v) / (hi - lo) * (H - m.t - m.b);
  yT.forEach(t => { el("line", {x1: m.l, x2: W - m.r, y1: sy(t), y2: sy(t), class: "gl"}, s); tx(s, m.l - 6, sy(t) + 4, t.toFixed(1), {class: "tick", "text-anchor": "end"}); });
  el("line", {x1: m.l, x2: W - m.r, y1: sy(0), y2: sy(0), stroke: "#7a828b"}, s);
  tx(s, 0, 0, "Share of log breadth gap", {class: "axt", "text-anchor": "middle", transform: `translate(${m.l - yw - 16},${(m.t + H - m.b) / 2}) rotate(-90)`});
  const w = Math.min(70, bw * 0.55);
  let acc = 0;
  const gT = el("g", {}, s);
  comps.forEach(c => { const a = acc, b = acc + c[2]; el("rect", {x: sx(0) - w / 2, y: sy(Math.max(a, b)), width: w, height: Math.abs(sy(a) - sy(b)), fill: c[4]}, gT); acc = b; });
  el("rect", {class: "hit", x: sx(0) - w / 2 - 4, y: sy(1) - 4, width: w + 8, height: sy(0) - sy(1) + 8, fill: "transparent"}, gT);
  markify(gT, `Total log gap ${r.D_total.toFixed(3)}`, `<b>Total gap</b><br>log breadth gap D = ${r.D_total.toFixed(3)}${r.D_total_ci ? ` [${r.D_total_ci[0].toFixed(3)}, ${r.D_total_ci[1].toFixed(3)}]` : ""}<br>shares stack to 1`);
  comps.forEach((c, i) => {
    const g = el("g", {}, s), x = sx(i + 1), v = c[2];
    el("rect", {class: "hit", x: x - w / 2 - 6, y: m.t, width: w + 12, height: H - m.t - m.b, fill: "transparent", rx: 4}, g);
    el("rect", {x: x - w / 2, y: sy(Math.max(0, v)), width: w, height: Math.abs(sy(v) - sy(0)), fill: c[4]}, g);
    if (c[3]) { el("line", {x1: x, x2: x, y1: sy(c[3][0]), y2: sy(c[3][1]), stroke: "var(--ink)", "stroke-width": 1.5}, g); [0, 1].forEach(k => el("line", {x1: x - 6, x2: x + 6, y1: sy(c[3][k]), y2: sy(c[3][k]), stroke: "var(--ink)", "stroke-width": 1.5}, g)); }
    tx(g, x + w / 2 + 4 > W - 20 ? x : x, sy(Math.max(v, c[3] ? c[3][1] : v)) - 6, v.toFixed(3), {"text-anchor": "middle", "font-size": 12, fill: "var(--ink)"});
    markify(g, `${c[1]}: share ${v.toFixed(3)}`, `<b>${c[1]}</b><br>share ${v.toFixed(3)}${c[3] ? ` [${c[3][0].toFixed(3)}, ${c[3][1].toFixed(3)}]` : ""}<br>95% percentile CI, 2,000 concept bootstraps`);
  });
  labs.forEach((l, i) => {
    const words = narrow ? l.split(" ") : [l];
    const t = tx(s, sx(i), H - m.b + 16, "", {class: "tick", "text-anchor": "middle"});
    if (narrow && words.length > 1) { const half = Math.ceil(words.length / 2); [words.slice(0, half).join(" "), words.slice(half).join(" ")].forEach((ln, k) => { const ts = el("tspan", {x: sx(i), dy: k ? 14 : 0}, t); ts.textContent = ln; }); }
    else t.textContent = l;
  });
  $("#dec-table").innerHTML = `<caption class="sr">Tercile averages</caption><thead><tr><th scope="col">Tercile of breadth</th><th scope="col">Concepts</th><th scope="col">Early contact E₂</th><th scope="col">Frontier advance M</th><th scope="col">Retention ρ</th></tr></thead><tbody>` +
    [["Top (integrating)", r.top], ["Bottom (localised)", r.bot]].map(([n, v]) => `<tr><td>${n}</td><td>${v.n.toLocaleString("en-US")}</td><td>${v.E.toFixed(2)}</td><td>${v.M.toFixed(2)}</td><td>${v.rho.toFixed(2)}</td></tr>`).join("") + `</tbody>`;
  $("#dec-take").textContent = `In ${r.label.toLowerCase()} (${r.n.toLocaleString("en-US")} concepts${dVar === "iv_vol_noMed_PR1" ? ", volume-stratified, Medicine homes excluded" : ", unstratified"}), early contact accounts for ${(100 * r.s_E2).toFixed(1)}% of the gap, retention for ${(100 * r.s_rho).toFixed(1)}% and frontier advance for ${(100 * r.s_M).toFixed(1)}%. Integrating concepts touch ${r.top.E.toFixed(1)} fields by t₀+2 against ${r.bot.E.toFixed(1)}, yet both multiply their fields by about the same factor later (${r.top.M.toFixed(2)} vs ${r.bot.M.toFixed(2)}).`;
}
segGroup("d-var", v => { dVar = v; drawDec(); });

/* =================== 4. TRY: top-k =================== */
const KUNITS = [["all4", "Held-out groups (pooled)", [0, 1, 2, 3]], ["cohort", "2010–14 cohort", [4, 5]], ...RK.units.map((u, i) => [u, UNIT_LABEL[u], [i]])];
$("#k-unit").innerHTML = KUNITS.map(k => `<option value="${k[0]}">${esc(k[1])}</option>`).join("");
$("#x-unit").innerHTML = KUNITS.map(k => `<option value="${k[0]}">${esc(k[1])}</option>`).join("");
$("#k-nstrata").textContent = RK.rows.length.toLocaleString("en-US");
$("#k-nevents").textContent = RK.rows.reduce((a, r) => a + r[2].length, 0).toLocaleString("en-US");
function hitCurves(units) {
  const set = new Set(units), R = RK.rows.filter(r => set.has(r[0]));
  const out = {n: 0, strata: R.length, r2: Array(11).fill(0), r3: Array(11).fill(0), rnd: Array(11).fill(0)};
  R.forEach(r => r[2].forEach((a, j) => { out.n++; const b = r[3][j]; for (let k = 1; k <= 10; k++) { if (a <= k) out.r2[k]++; if (b <= k) out.r3[k]++; out.rnd[k] += Math.min(k, r[1]) / r[1]; } }));
  for (let k = 1; k <= 10; k++) { out.r2[k] /= out.n; out.r3[k] /= out.n; out.rnd[k] /= out.n; }
  return out;
}
function drawK() {
  const k = +$("#k-range").value, u = KUNITS.find(x => x[0] === $("#k-unit").value), H0 = hitCurves(u[2]);
  $("#k-out").textContent = `k = ${k}`;
  $("#k-range").setAttribute("aria-valuetext", `${k} fields`);
  const C = $("#k-chart"), W = width(C), H = 280;
  const yT = [0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1], yw = Math.max(...yT.map(t => textW((t * 100) + "%", 12)));
  const m = {l: 24 + yw + 14, r: 16, t: 14, b: 44};
  const s = newSvg(C, W, H, "Share of entries on the shortlist, by shortlist size");
  const sx = kk => m.l + (kk - 1) / 9 * (W - m.l - m.r), sy = v => m.t + (1 - v) * (H - m.t - m.b);
  yT.forEach(t => { el("line", {x1: m.l, x2: W - m.r, y1: sy(t), y2: sy(t), class: "gl"}, s); tx(s, m.l - 6, sy(t) + 4, (t * 100).toFixed(0) + "%", {class: "tick", "text-anchor": "end"}); });
  for (let kk = 1; kk <= 10; kk++) tx(s, sx(kk), H - m.b + 16, String(kk), {class: "tick", "text-anchor": "middle"});
  tx(s, (m.l + W - m.r) / 2, H - 8, "Shortlist size k (fields)", {class: "axt", "text-anchor": "middle"});
  tx(s, 0, 0, "Entered field on shortlist", {class: "axt", "text-anchor": "middle", transform: `translate(${m.l - yw - 16},${(m.t + H - m.b) / 2}) rotate(-90)`});
  el("line", {x1: sx(k), x2: sx(k), y1: m.t, y2: H - m.b, stroke: "var(--focus)", "stroke-width": 2}, s);
  const series = [["rnd", "Random shortlist", "#7a828b", "4 3"], ["r2", "Baseline R2", "var(--base)", ""], ["r3", "With retained frontier R3", "var(--accent)", ""]];
  series.forEach(([key, nm, col, dash]) => {
    el("polyline", {points: [...Array(10)].map((_, i) => `${sx(i + 1)},${sy(H0[key][i + 1])}`).join(" "), fill: "none", stroke: col, "stroke-width": key === "rnd" ? 1.5 : 2.5, "stroke-dasharray": dash}, s);
  });
  for (let kk = 1; kk <= 10; kk++) {
    const g = el("g", {}, s);
    el("rect", {class: "hit", x: sx(kk) - 12, y: m.t, width: 24, height: H - m.t - m.b, fill: "transparent", rx: 4}, g);
    [["r2", "var(--base)"], ["r3", "var(--accent)"]].forEach(([key, col]) => el("circle", {cx: sx(kk), cy: sy(H0[key][kk]), r: kk === k ? 6 : 3.5, fill: col}, g));
    markify(g, `k ${kk}: R2 ${pct(H0.r2[kk])}, R3 ${pct(H0.r3[kk])}, random ${pct(H0.rnd[kk])}`, `<b>Shortlist of ${kk}</b><br>R3 ${pct(H0.r3[kk])} · R2 ${pct(H0.r2[kk])} · random ${pct(H0.rnd[kk])}<br>${H0.n.toLocaleString("en-US")} entries in ${H0.strata.toLocaleString("en-US")} strata`);
  }
  const d = H0.r3[k] - H0.r2[k];
  $("#k-take").textContent = `${u[1]}: with a shortlist of ${k}, the baseline catches ${pct(H0.r2[k])} of the ${H0.n.toLocaleString("en-US")} entries and the retained-frontier model ${pct(H0.r3[k])} (${d >= 0 ? "+" : "−"}${(100 * Math.abs(d)).toFixed(1)} points); a random shortlist would catch ${pct(H0.rnd[k])}. Most of the ranking comes from the baseline covariates, field size above all.`;
}
$("#k-range").addEventListener("input", drawK);
$("#k-unit").addEventListener("change", drawK);

/* =================== 4b. TRY: retained toggles =================== */
let keep = null;
function renderTry() {
  const c = tryCase; keep = new Set(c.retained);
  $("#t-case").innerHTML = `Concept-year: <strong>${esc(c.name)}, ${c.year}</strong> (${esc(UNIT_LABEL[c.unit])})`;
  $("#t-ret").innerHTML = c.retained.length ? c.retained.map(f => `<label class="chk"><input type="checkbox" value="${f}" checked> ${esc(fname(f))}</label>`).join("") : `<span class="note">No field retains this concept yet, so d₀ is zero for every candidate.</span>`;

/* =================== 5. FAILS =================== */

let eFeat = "OPEN_home";

  - A forest plot by domain group, with a switch between Wald and bootstrap intervals and a checkbox that adds the null volume-matched contrast.
  - The baseline model ladder, with a switch between the two relatedness definitions. It shows the within-stratum AUC going from 0.847 to 0.852, and adding nothing under the alternative definition.
- **How it works:** a 6-stage stepper follows one real record, *Liminality* in 2012. The page recomputes *d*₀ from the field network (0.508, the same as recorded) and reruns the frozen model in JavaScript. Its probabilities match the recorded ones to within 0.0007, which is the rounding of the recorded inputs. The field actually entered, Health Professions, moves from rank 7 to rank 3.
- **Explore:**
  - A browser over 301 real concept-years, with filter, search, sort and a failures-only toggle. The detail panel shows the baseline and full-model probabilities side by side.
  - The indicator screen, whose values match the paper's Table 1 exactly, next to the learned model against the popularity baseline (+0.059).
